content: Application access to snapshot record data Description: he diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall provide access to snapshot record data to applications. If this functionality is configured for an event, diagnostics shall notify the application every time the data in the snapshot record changes. Rationale: Data provided in a snapshot record (like time stamp) can be of special interest for applications and is used for further vehicle functionalities. Use Case: Realizing a central error state handler within a vehicle. But there can be other use cases like providing data synchronizing within the vehicle or cloud.
